d:
Aboard the Polar icebreaker cruise! Did you know icebreakers and swimming in icy cold water was a thing? This activity feels like it was straight out of a movie or a storybook.
But in today’s video, I'm not only travelling from Finland to Sweden but also randomly experiencing the Northern Lights and some Finnish hospitality.
We're diving into a one-of-a-kind icebreaker cruise experience, swimming in the frozen waters and hiking up the Korouoma Canyon to see frozen waterfalls.
